channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Kahn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Kahn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Curry on David Kahn
item.description:
Curry brought this up in a 2014 interview with the Star Tribune's Jerry Zgoda, and he advanced that theory to a national audience again recently when he appeared on Bill Simmons' podcast.

“My guy David Kahn. I don't know where he's at right now,”

Stephen Curry on David Kahn, Aug 17, 2018. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Corey Brewer on David Kahn
item.description:
Brewer said from his Denver home.

“As soon as I got drafted, he got traded. They were trying to build stuff, had a different coach every year, and I knew when David Kahn took over, I was out of there.”

Corey Brewer on David Kahn, Jul 14, 2013. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Glen Taylor on David Kahn
item.description:
“We were prepared to go ahead, and then (Kahn) went back and talked to Rick, and Rick said he wanted to come in and interview.”

Glen Taylor on David Kahn, Sep 21, 2011. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.
